question: Does the minimal physical generic-Q detach/loop-weight generator reopen, or uniquely select a direction in, the empty width-3/4 Gram/source affine-intertwiner intersection found at 96df7c8?

representation.module: V_w is the rational vector space on circular noncrossing connectivity states in repository order
representation.join: e_i joins periodic sites i and i+1 with unit coefficient
representation.translation: T rotates every site forward by one
representation.detach: D_i(Q)|pi> is |pi with i split into a singleton> if the block of i has size greater than one, and Q|pi> if i is already singleton
representation.normalization: The non-singleton detach coefficient is exactly one and the completed singleton loop coefficient is exactly Q; no additional edge, cluster or transfer weight is absorbed into D_i
representation.full_Q_lift: Work over Q[epsilon]/(epsilon^2) at Q=1+epsilon, with D_i=D_i(1)+epsilon P_i and X=X0+epsilon V; P_i projects columns whose state already has singleton i
representation.gram: G(Q)_(pi,sigma)=Q^{blocks(pi vee sigma)}; G0=all-ones and G1_(pi,sigma)=blocks(pi vee sigma); H=B^T G1 B
representation.source: s0 is the all-singleton connectivity state

frozen_equations.gram_radical: For A0 induced by X0 B=B A0, require H A0=A0^T H. This is exactly the radical projection of the epsilon coefficient of G(Q)X(Q)=X(Q)^T G(Q); the V terms vanish because B^T G0=G0 B=0.
frozen_equations.secondary_full_gram_check: Separately report whether the unprojected epsilon equation G1 X0+G0 V=X0^T G1+V^T G0 is solvable; it cannot weaken the primary radical condition.

analysis_ladder: generic-Q affine Hom jet: joins plus translation plus detach
plus endpoint normalization through first order
plus all-singleton source normalization through first order

outputs.dimensions: Report exact affine tangent dimensions at every stage for the joint variables (X0,V).
outputs.base_and_velocity: When nonempty, give exact particular X0,V and primitive-integer tangent directions.
outputs.velocity_radical_overlap: When the final intersection is nonempty, report the rank and exact matrix of the induced radical velocity B^{-1}VB.
outputs.empty_certificate: When inconsistent, give an exact left-null witness y^T C=0 but y^T b=1 and identify whether its support is purely order-zero or uses velocity equations.
outputs.full_Q_boundary: Record the polynomial detach definition and the Q=1 first jet; do not infer a continuum LCFT or Jordan identity.

decision_rule.reopened_unique: The final joint affine system is consistent with tangent dimension zero.
decision_rule.reopened_moduli: The final joint affine system is consistent with positive tangent dimension.
decision_rule.remains_empty: The final joint affine system is inconsistent.
decision_rule.zeroth_order_no_go: The inconsistency is already implied by the order-zero projection and therefore no allowed velocity can repair it.

claim_boundary: This is exact rational first-jet algebra at Q=1 in widths 2,3,4 only.
The detach operator is the minimal FK connectivity detach; no occupied-edge transfer matrix, marked cluster fugacity, or higher Q jet is included.
A nonempty microscopic intersection would not by itself identify an LCFT field or the formal K of PR #393.
An empty intersection rules out this declared minimal lift only; a larger marked or direct-sum module can carry additional extension data.
